Every task is evaluated immediately with hidden file, behavior-contract, syntax, network, and scope checks. Per-step token samples include idle gaps; cache share excluding steps after gaps over 180s is reported as idle-adjusted.

tasks.title: Keyboard-friendly calculator

no:external-network-assets.detail: no external network asset or fetch found

scope:only-current-project.detail: files outside the current project were unchanged

tasks.finalMessage: Done. `projects/calculator-web-app` contains exactly `index.html`, `styles.css`, `app.js`, and `README.md` — nothing else modified. **Features** — digits + decimal, `+ − × ÷`, equals (full equation shown on a secondary line), AC clear, ⌫ backspace, and full keyboard support (`0-9 . + - * / Enter Esc Backspace`). The display is an `aria-live="polite" aria-atomic="true"` region; ambiguous keys carry descriptive `aria-label`s; the keypad is a labeled `role="group"` with visible `:focus-visible` states and a skip link. **Edge cases inspected & tested** — I executed the app's pure state machine headlessly in Node across 16 scenario groups, all passing: - Division by zero → friendly "Cannot divide by 0" state; any digit recovers; equals/backspace during error are safe - Operator spam replaces the operator instead of building malformed input (`5 + × ÷ =` → `1`) - Left-to-right chaining (`2 + 3 × 4 =` → `20`), equals with nothing pending is a no-op - Float drift cleaned via 12-significant-digit rounding (`0.1 + 0.2 =` → exactly `0.3`), non-terminating results fine - Double decimals blocked, leading zeros collapse, entry capped at 16 digits, overflow never prints `Infinity` - Backspace rests safely at `0` through `-`, `.`, and empty states Two initial test failures were harness bugs (raw ASCII operators bypassing the key map; a wrong expectation for backspacing `"3."`) — the shipped code was correct in both cases. Static checks also pass: HTML parses with no mismatches, every JS-referenced ID exists, every keypad `data-key` is handled by the dispatcher, CSS braces balanced with tokens + responsive breakpoints (`22rem`/`30rem`/coarse-pointer/reduced-motion), zero external references.
